title: Professional Development in Marketing
description: Define purpose for education, life and professional pursuits in marketing. Explore personal and professional goals. Engage in work fit and career assessments. Determine learning and working style preferences. Develop well-being practices. Practice effective business communication and etiquette techniques.
notes: Not open to students with credit in B A 305

title: Marketing and Sales Micro-internship
description: Micro-internship with business firms, government agencies, or nonprofit organizations. Under joint supervision of intern organization and course instructor students pursue a small scale project or short term internship. Fundamentals of sales and marketing in a real-world context.

title: Consumer Behavior
description: Consumer behavior concepts and theories for developing, implementing, and assessing marketing strategy. Psychological, social, and environmental factors in understanding of needs, wants, preferences, and decision making related to consumption behaviors.

title: Retail Marketing Methods
description: Retailing industry and retailer strategy to include online retailers, multi-channel retailing, consumer behavior, retail market strategy, site selection, locations, human resource management, merchandise management, pricing, marketing communications strategy, store layout, design, and management.

title: Integrated Marketing Communications
description: Communication theory in context of integrating marketing communication tools to include advertising; digital, social, nontraditional media; sales promotion; public relations. Media planning and strategy, budgeting, effectiveness measurement, social/ethical issues, regulation of advertising and promotion.

title: Global Marketing Strategy
description: International marketing concepts. Assessing organization internationalization potential, external environmental analysis for global market segmentation, target country market selection, entry strategies, international product, pricing decisions, analysis of international distribution systems, developing international advertising and promotion programs.

title: Selling Strategy and Practices
description: Marketing and sales process. Theories, approaches, techniques used in selling process, development of sales presentations, and use of partnering/relationship selling and technology in professional selling.

title: Direct Marketing Methods
description: Direct marketing as part of a company or organization’s marketing program. Major direct marketing media and methods to include direct mail, broadcast and print advertising, Internet and interactive media, catalogs, and telemarketing. Data base creation and management and effectiveness measurement for direct marketing programs.

title: Introduction to Business Tools for Data Analysis and Visualization
description: Tools for organizing data and interpreting results. Creating, editing, and interacting with spreadsheets. Development of advanced tables, charts, data views, and dashboards. Use of data visualization to communicate insights.

title: Marketing and Sales Internship
description: Internship with business firms, government agencies, or nonprofit organizations. Under joint supervision of intern organization and course instructor. Fundamentals of sales and marketing in a real-world context.

title: Marketing Research
description: Marketing research process. Research design and data collection principles for qualitative and quantitative research techniques in marketing practice. Analysis, data visualization, and reporting of primary and secondary marketing research.

title: Sales Management
description: Management of recruitment, training, motivation, and compensation of the sales personnel of a company. Policies and procedures used for organization, evaluation, and control of the sales force.

title: Business Marketing
description: Marketing strategy and practices designed for organizational customers. Purchasing practices of organizational buyers and development of marketing programs for enterprise customers and markets, both domestic and global.

title: Internet/Interactive Marketing
description: Impact of networked, cloud, mobile and contextual technologies on consumer behavior, business and marketing practice. Marketing communication and strategy leveraging the Internet to include search optimization, user experience design, social media, contextual advertising, pricing, distribution, commerce, and analytics.

title: Sustainable Marketing
description: Strategy for sustainable and regenerative marketing practices and business models. Explores aspects of consumer behavior, public policy, and market research to develop triple bottom line business solutions. Development of recommendations for sustainable marketing strategy applied to real world client vignettes.

title: Marketing and Sales for Social Impact
description: Marketing and sales planning to solve social or environmental issues. Management of marketing and sales functions to address pressing needs at the base of the economic pyramid, underserved communities, or markets affected by environmental problems.

title: Marketing Analytics
description: Analysis and interpretation of large, complex data sets (Big Data). Theory, analytical approaches to solve marketing problems, utilizing software tools for marketing and sales decision making.

title: Advanced Marketing Analytics
description: Advanced analysis and interpretation of complex marketing data. Students apply experimental design, regression, conjoint analysis, and machine learning to real-world problems using analytical software. Emphasizes data storytelling, evidence-based decision-making, and collaboration through a semester long marketing analytics project.

title: Customer Experience Design
description: Integration of marketing perspectives from behavioral science, data analytics, human-centered design, and emerging technologies such as AI and automation. Students apply interdisciplinary theories related to consumer behavior to design customer-centric experiences that enhance service, loyalty, satisfaction, and overall brand equity.

title: Advanced Integrated Marketing Communications
description: Management of marketing communications function with emphasis on integration and coordination of all activities. Planning, implementation, and coordination of marketing communications activities. Development, implementation, and program evaluation of an integrated marketing communications project.

title: Sustainable Marketing Consulting
description: Advanced applications of sustainable and regenerative marketing strategy emphasizing consulting practice. Integrates consumer insight, market intelligence, systems innovation, and policy strategy to design circular, stakeholder-centered marketing strategy. Students deliver data-driven, triple-bottom-line marketing consulting solutions through experiential projects with real-world organizations.
notes: Recommended: Completion of MKTG 478-Marketing for Social Impact or concurrent enrollment.

title: Advanced Strategic Marketing
description: Marketing concepts and decision tools for analyzing and solving marketing problems; marketing strategy and plans; problem identification, evaluation of alternatives, strategic and tactical recommendations.

title: Marketing and Sales Applications
description: Integrative course that applies key marketing or sales concepts through real-world consulting or student research projects. Students work in teams to diagnose and solve marketing challenges faced by local businesses, non-profits, or organizations to develop marketing insights or recommendations.

title: Selected Topics in Marketing
description: Selected areas of concern in marketing.
notes: Limit of nine units of any combination of 296, 496, 596 courses applicable to a bachelor’s degree. See

title: Investigation and Report
description: A comprehensive and original study of a problem connected with marketing under the direction of one or more members of the marketing staff.

title: Special Study
description: Individual study.

title: Cause Selling and Fundraising
description: Cause selling strategies and tactics. Integration of cause selling and marketing through relationship management, planning and delivery of donor presentations, the use of technology and analytics, and trust-building techniques to engage prospects.

title: Seminar in Selected Topics
description: Intensive study in specific areas of marketing.

title: Contemporary Issues in Marketing Theory and Practice
description: Issues in marketing theory and practice: examination and application of contemporary theories and techniques in relation to changes in marketing environment.

title: Product Innovation Management
description: New product development and issues related to overall management of product innovation in context of entrepreneurial opportunity, start-up ventures and existing organizations. Focus on planning, design, and implementation of marketing strategy.

title: Seminar in Sales Management
description: Sales management and personal selling decisions and strategies in business organizations.

title: Sales and Marketing Analytics
description: Communicating, reporting, and visualizing analytics to inform decision making. Descriptive, predictive, prescriptive modeling of data to address sales and marketing problems. Utilizing market intelligence and consumer response data to inform development.

title: Seminar in Internet Marketing and E-Business
description: Theory and application of marketing utilizing the Internet and associated issues of electronic commerce.

title: Seminar in International Marketing
description: The impact of cultural, social, political, economic, and other environmental variables on international marketing systems and the decision-making process of multinational marketing operations.

title: Strategic Brand Management
description: Planning, managing, and evaluating brand strategies. Theories, models, concepts, and techniques used to build, measure, and manage brand equity. Marketing decisions faced by an organization in managing brands for long-term profitability.

title: Research
description: Research in the area of marketing.

title: Special Study
description: Individual study.
